JOL.P.2.28-32.text: I Will Pour Out My Spirit

JOL.1.1-3.text: Joel calls the elders to tell children about this event

JOL.1.4-4.text: Four kinds of locusts eat all the crops

JOL.1.5-7.text: Drunkards must weep because locusts ruined the vines

JOL.1.8-10.text: The land and the priests mourn for the lost harvest

JOL.1.11-12.text: Farmers must wail because the harvest and trees have died

JOL.1.13-14.text: Joel tells the priests to mourn and call a fast

JOL.1.15-17.text: Joel warns that the Day of the LORD is near

JOL.1.18-20.text: Joel cries to the LORD because animals suffer from drought

JOL.2.1-2.text: The alarm sounds because the Day of the LORD is near

JOL.2.3-3.text: A fire follows the army and the land becomes a desert

JOL.2.4-5.text: The locusts look like horses and sound like chariots

JOL.2.6-7.text: Nations fear the army, which marches like soldiers

JOL.2.8-9.text: The locusts enter the city and the houses

JOL.2.10-11.text: The earth shakes before the LORD’s army on a dreadful day

JOL.2.12-13.text: The LORD tells the people to return to him sincerely

JOL.2.14-14.text: Joel hopes God may relent and leave a blessing

JOL.2.15-16.text: Joel tells all the people to gather for a holy fast

JOL.2.17-17.text: Priests must weep and ask the LORD to spare the people

JOL.2.18-19.text: The LORD pities His people and promises grain, wine and oil

JOL.2.20-20.text: God will drive the northern army out of the land

JOL.2.21-23.text: God tells the land and the people of Zion to be glad

JOL.2.24-25.text: God promises full harvests and repays the locust years

JOL.2.26-27.text: God’s people will be satisfied and never put to shame

JOL.2.28-29.text: God will pour out his Spirit on all people

JOL.2.30-31.text: God will show wonders before the Day of the LORD

JOL.2.32-32.text: God will save everyone who calls on his name

JOL.3.1-3.text: God will judge the nations for harming Israel

JOL.3.4-6.text: God accuses Tyre, Sidon and Philistia of robbing Judah

JOL.3.7-8.text: God will sell the enemies’ children to Judah

JOL.3.9-10.text: God tells the nations to prepare for war

JOL.3.11-11.text: Nations must gather as the LORD brings his mighty ones

JOL.3.12-13.text: The LORD will judge the wicked nations like a harvest

JOL.3.14-15.text: The Day of the LORD is near for the many nations

JOL.3.16-16.text: The LORD will protect Israel and shake heaven and earth

JOL.3.17-17.text: God will live in Zion and Jerusalem will be holy

JOL.3.18-19.text: God will bless Judah and make Egypt and Edom desolate

JOL.3.20-21.text: Judah will last forever and God will avenge its blood
